details.description: Cogito v1-preview-llama-8B is a hybrid-reasoning chat model from Deep Cogito, fine-tuned from Meta's Llama-3.1-8B base checkpoint and released April 8, 2025 as a preview. It uses Deep Cogito's Iterated Distillation and Amplification (IDA) training method, lets a user toggle between answering directly or self-reflecting before answering, and was trained in over 30 languages with tool-calling support. Deep Cogito has since released newer Cogito v2 Preview (July 2025) and Cogito v2.1 (November 2025) generations.
advantages: Supports a toggleable hybrid-reasoning mode: it can answer directly like a standard chat model, or self-reflect before answering, per its model card.
Supports single, parallel, multiple and parallel-multiple tool/function calling in both standard and thinking modes, per its model card.
Trained in over 30 languages, per Deep Cogito's model card.
disadvantages: Preview release (v1-preview); Deep Cogito has since released newer Cogito v2 Preview (July 2025) and Cogito v2.1 (November 2025) generations.
Not optimized for very long reasoning chains, per Deep Cogito, which designed the thinking mode for shorter self-reflection rather than extended chain-of-thought.
use_cases: Agentic applications requiring tool or function calling, in either standard or extended-thinking mode.
Multilingual chat and instruction-following tasks across 30+ languages.
Coding and STEM tasks, per Deep Cogito's positioning of the Cogito family.
Tasks where a user wants to toggle between fast direct answers and slower self-reflective reasoning.

notes: Catalog facts list max tokens as 131072 (~128K), matching the model card's 128k context window, so kept as-is. No numeric benchmark scores were legible from Deep Cogito's benchmark chart images (only image comparisons against Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek R1 are shown), so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. Checked Deep Cogito's research index, its HF org page and the v2-preview announcement: v2 Preview (July 2025) and v2.1 (November 2025) were released later, but no page calls v1-preview deprecated or superseded, and the v1-preview models remain listed without any such notice, so the description now just states the later releases exist rather than asserting supersession.
